warnings.reason: Very small screen-right eye/muzzle bias relative to 000; the right component is subtle. Same clear raised-chin/upward-eyed family as 000. Aggregated blind horizontal axis was ambiguous; native labeled/ordered review confirms a weak right component with clear up.

Clear screen-right pupil/muzzle aim. Chin/eye aim remains slightly elevated compared with 090; vertical component is restrained. Aggregated blind vertical axis was ambiguous; labeled comparison with 090 supports shallow up-right.

Pupils and muzzle remain biased to screen-right. Head pitches down from 090, eyelids lower and muzzle/chin descend; shallow down-right is readable. Aggregated blind vertical axis was ambiguous; labeled comparison with 090/135 supports shallow down-right.
The muzzle/eyes shift slightly screen-left relative to 180, but this near-vertical left component is weak. Clearly bowed-head/downward-eyed family; downward component is strong.

Head, muzzle and both eyes aim clearly toward screen-left. Slight downward pitch/lowered lids and a lower muzzle than the level-left family support shallow down-left; the downward component is much weaker than the left component. Aggregated blind vertical axis was ambiguous; lowered lids/slight down pitch plus ordered down-left family support a shallow down component.

Screen-left head turn and pupil aim are definite. Only a small remaining down-pitch/low-eyelid cue distinguishes it from 270; it nearly reads as level-left. Ordered 202.5 -> 225 -> 247.5 -> 270 progression supports the intended quadrant, with no upward or opposite-quadrant cue.

Muzzle and pupils clearly turn screen-left. Chin starts lifting and eye aim rises relative to 270, giving a shallow but readable upward component. Aggregated blind vertical axis was ambiguous; raised chin/eye aim relative to 270 supports shallow up-left.

Head/muzzle yaw and minor clothing/wing pose changes are larger than some within-row steps, consistent with the reported diff outlier. Feet/torso anchor, practical scale and bow grip remain coherent; no conspicuous registration/identity/scale snap is confirmed.
Up-left yaw returns toward centered-up with a larger change than the close 315/337.5 pair. Upward attention, body anchor and prop contact continue; no visible reversal or conspicuous scale snap.
Focused-work/thinking action is restrained; head dip, hand-to-chin and outward hand motion distinguish it from idle.
User-approved light-hop gait; narrower3/4 silhouette and preview final-frame220ms hold.
